levels.description: For every party member other than the equipping character: · Who is of the same Elemental Type as the equipper: The equipping character's Elemental Mastery is increased by 64; · Who is not of the same Elemental Type as the equipper: The equipping character's ATK increases by 12%. The two effects described above can stack up to 3 times in total, with Elemental Mastery buffs applied first.
